Document/Node Encode and EncodedSize use the explicit-destination variants with the original Format; default-format wrappers add no operation. Returned output is owned Go memory rather than a borrowed native destination.

Go checks shared-owner generation before dereferencing every Node and invalidates all handles after successful edits. Node.Identity exposes the live identity. Native revision/retirement counters and stale-address scans are internal lifetime mechanisms, not public Go pointer operations.

Document.EncodedSize measures the complete canonical encoding and supplies the same snapshot bound already used by EvaluateDocument with negative capacity. Native discovery exposes caller-owned Tree Writer scratch; Go owns this staging and does not expose an allocation-free workspace contract.

CompileQuery uses the explicit-length compile and scratch variants, including embedded-NUL syntax validation; NUL-terminated wrappers add no functionality. Reset recreates bounded execution storage and clears copied inputs/bindings. Finalized pulls use result_next_at to preserve ordinal identity.
